trimmed_dict.title: Psychiatry Club - Clinical Psychiatry Simulation: Integrating Diagnosis, Communication, and Care
trimmed_dict.date: Tuesday, April 21, 2026 5pm to 6pm
trimmed_dict.description: An interactive psychiatry simulation series where students create and work through realistic patient encounters. Sessions emphasize DSM-5 diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making, and effective communication, with guided debriefs to reinforce key concepts and skills.
